description: This file defines SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) protection policies and URL validation functions, including hostname allowlist normalization and URL protocol checks.

methods.name: ssrfPolicyFromAllowPrivateNetwork
methods.description: Creates an SSRF policy object allowing private network access based on a boolean input.

methods.name: assertHttpUrlTargetsPrivateNetwork
methods.description: Validates that an HTTP URL targets a private network, throwing errors if not compliant.

methods.name: normalizeHostnameSuffix
methods.description: Normalizes hostname suffix patterns, handling wildcards and trimming.

methods.name: isHostnameAllowedBySuffixAllowlist
methods.description: Checks if a hostname matches an allowlist with suffix patterns.

methods.name: normalizeHostnameSuffixAllowlist
methods.description: Converts input allowlist into normalized, lowercase, wildcard-collapsed entries.

methods.name: isHttpsUrlAllowedByHostnameSuffixAllowlist
methods.description: Checks if an HTTPS URL's hostname matches the allowlist.

methods.name: buildHostnameAllowlistPolicyFromSuffixAllowlist
methods.description: Builds an SSRF hostname allowlist policy from suffix-style allowlist entries.
